src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: New item request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: The request to add a new item, such as a feed type, to the inventory list.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Inventory test data access
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Reads sample inventory data for the simulation setup; not available in production.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Inventory contract
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Lists everything the rest of the app can ask the inventory area to do, such as items, stock lots, movements, feed and water use.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Stock correction request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: The request to correct stock up or down, or to write off spoiled stock.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Feeding request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: The request to record feed given to a flock on a day, and the reply with its cost.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Stock purchase request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: The request to record stock bought, with quantity, cost and supplier details.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Water use request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: The request to record water used by a flock on a day, from a quantity or from meter readings.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Edit item request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: The request to change an inventory item's details.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Water correction request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: The request to correct a water record; its flock and date stay fixed.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Add inventory item
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Adds a new item to the inventory list.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: New item check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Checks a new inventory item has valid details before it is added.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Feed use storage
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Describes how feeding records are saved; they can only be added, and mistakes are fixed through stock corrections.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Item storage
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Describes how inventory items are loaded and saved, including total stock on hand per item.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Stock lot storage
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Describes how received batches of stock are loaded and saved.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Stock history storage
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Describes how the stock history is saved; entries can only be added, never edited or removed.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Inventory service
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Carries out inventory requests such as adding items, receiving stock, feeding and water records.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Water use storage
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Describes how water records are loaded and saved; unlike feed records they can be corrected in place.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Correct stock
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Fixes a wrong purchase or writes off spoiled stock by adding a correcting entry, leaving the original untouched.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Stock correction check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Checks a stock correction has valid details before it is recorded.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Record feeding
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Records feed given to a flock, using up the oldest stock first and noting which batches were used.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Feeding check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Checks a feeding record has valid details before it is saved.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Receive stock
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Records stock bought by creating the new batch and its history entry together.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Purchase check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Checks a stock purchase has valid details before it is recorded.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Record water use
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Records the water a flock used on a day.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Water use check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Checks a water record is valid, including that meter readings agree with the quantity.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Turn item on or off
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Marks an inventory item as in use or retired.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Edit inventory item
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Changes an inventory item's details, refusing if someone else edited it first.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Edit item check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Checks edited item details are valid before saving.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Correct water record
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Corrects an existing water record, refusing if someone else changed it first.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.name: Water correction check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Genera.description: Checks a corrected water record is valid before saving.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/GeneralInve.name: Feeding record
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/GeneralInve.description: One feeding event: how much of an item a flock ate on a day.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/GeneralInve.name: Inventory item
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/GeneralInve.description: An entry in the inventory list, such as a feed type; other categories like medicine are planned for later.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/GeneralInve.name: Stock lot
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/GeneralInve.description: One received batch of an item, with its own cost, optional supplier batch number and expiry date.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/GeneralInve.name: Stock history entry
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/GeneralInve.description: One line in the permanent stock history (purchase, use, correction); entries are never edited or deleted.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/GeneralInve.name: Water use record
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/GeneralInve.description: Water used by a flock on a day, with its source and optional meter readings.
